steps.content: The Apostle is gravely damaged, its body covered in burn marks from the Aurum Secretum's searing energy.
The underground Aurum Secretum has all been consumed, and now a violent storm engulfs Hypatia as Mania corrupts the resonant energy within her body.
Suddenly, the howling winds fall silent for a moment. Hypatia hears an agonized shriek pierce through the stillness.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Is that...
Above her, the barrier that should have been disabled is beginning to glow again!
[Background - WhiteSands]

The Furorians gather outside the rocky outcrop. Though the Aurum Secretum in their hands are all shattered pieces, together they form a continuous field, reactivating the external Aurum Secretum devices and reconnecting the system.
The Legionnaires stand right beside the Furorians, the two groups exchanging wary glances. Despite lingering tensions between them, they can still work together toward a common goal.
Part by part, the barrier lights up, gradually forming a starry sky in daylight above Furor. This shimmering galaxy will completely trap the Apostle within Furor's boundaries.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: A good lie needs to be mixed in with some truth. Uh, an old friend from WhiteSands taught me that. She's not the most trustworthy person per se, but her tricks sure work! See? Just put it to good use, didn't I?
Indeed, her method worked. Hella has successfully deceived her once again. They've never really given up on Furor or Hypatia.

steps.speaker: Furorian
steps.content: Show that thing what you're made of, Lady Campbell!

The Apostle roars in fury, realizing it has no escape. It summons a surge of black sand, from which countless tormented souls who died in the disasters reach out toward Hypatia, attempting to drag her down into hell with them.

steps.speaker: Anguished Shriek
steps.content: You betrayed us... You couldn't save anyone... You just stood by and watched as we died...

steps.speaker: Anguished Shriek
steps.content: You're useless! Stop struggling!

Hypatia stands unwavering, even as Mania leaves its corrosive marks across her skin. The light surrounding her body keeps growing brighter, gradually overwhelming the dark swirling sand until she becomes the sole source of radiance in the darkness.
The Apostle begins to tremble, sensing the threat before it.

steps.speaker: Anguished Shriek
steps.content: What do you even want? Why, why won't you just give up?!
Hypatia's voice is hoarse. The burden of the Ash Crystal nearly crushes her, yet she drags her body forward with unwavering determination.
She takes one step, then another. As the resonance surpasses its limits, the Aurum Secretum begins to boil, merging into Hypatia's skin and forming golden patterns across her body.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I want courage and strength... I want to stand tall with a clear conscience, to set things right, to protect my people...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I want sunlight to pierce through the dark clouds and shine over Furor... I want...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...That one day, all hopes in this place can become reality.
The world shakes violently as the Apostle's crystal core is exposed in the storm. The Apostle concentrates its energy, preparing to deliver one final strike.
But Hypatia... she chooses to remove all her defense. Her power gathers into a single point, poised to strike...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: This is what I've been seeking all along, the TRUE GLORY.
—BOOM!
Light impales the sky like a second sun rising from the depths of Furor, completely tearing through the veil of sand and dust.
Hypatia falls back, ultimately swallowed by the aftershock of the energy. But just as her consciousness begins to fade, she hears someone calling out.
...Hypatia!
[White light, transition to background after 3s] [Background - City Center - Day]
The sand and dust gradually settle, revealing the city's appearance.
The caves and buildings have been destroyed in the intense battle, reduced to ruins and rubble. The explosion has created a massive crater leading to the underground at the city center.
When the Furorians are escorted back into the city by the Legion, they're greeted by this scene of complete devastation.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: She just ran down there... Damn it! Hella? Hella, where are you?!

steps.speaker: Zade
steps.content: And Miss Campbell, she's gone too...
Horo races through the city, desperately searching for any sign of Hella. Other townsfolk join the search, their faces etched with worry.
Everyone searches frantically, calling out, but no response comes. Post-battle Furor lies in ruins, without a single soul in sight.
Finally, someone finds a damaged golden rose insignia at the edge of the massive crater.
The crowd parts, creating a path. Horo steps forward and notices several crushed, bloodstained beads next to the insignia. They're Hella's hair accessories.
A deathly silence falls over everyone. Only the soft sounds of stifled sobbing break the stillness.
Granny Nysa silently embraces Zade. Taric rubs his eyes, while Rosse hangs his head, face buried in his palms. A heavy gloom settles over everyone.
Only Zade continues to fidget restlessly beneath Granny Nysa's cloak.

steps.speaker: Zade
steps.content: Wait, wait! Look over there!
[CG - Supporting Each Other Post-Battle A]

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Is that...
Two figures appear in the swirling dust, supporting each other as they stumble forward with determination, emerging step by step.
The two silhouettes are growing larger and clearer. They're...
[CG - Supporting Each Other Post-Battle B]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The one and only, incredibly amazing, totally unbeatable hero Hella is back—safe and sound!

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Hella!

steps.speaker: Zade
steps.content: And Hypatia too! They're back!
Though covered in wounds, their steps grow quicker and lighter with each stride. Hella's face breaks into an enormous grin.
The crowd erupts in thunderous cheers as everyone rushes forward, surrounding Hella and Hypatia in a tight circle.

steps.speaker: Zade
steps.content: We won! We beat the big monster! We won!
[Background - City Center - Day]
Surrounded by the crowd, Hypatia appears flustered and overwhelmed, even stammering a little as she tries to speak.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I, ugh...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But logically, I shouldn't have been able to block that final attack... Someone else stepped in to defend me... Who was it?
Hypatia turns her head to find a mischievous grin on Hella's face.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hehehe, actually...
[Flashback Filter]
Synex leaps down the rock face, intending to flee, but gets intercepted by two figures.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: You came to recover the stuff hidden underground? So sorry, but we've already cleaned the place out.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: And I'm sure you wouldn't want your lady to become the Apostle's sweet treat, would you? So, how about making a deal with us?
Voice trembling slightly, the woman can't help lifting the corners of her mouth into a smile.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Interesting. I like it. Care to elaborate?
[End of Flashback Filter]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We said we cleaned the place out. We never said we actually took anything. That didn't count as a lie.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But she disappeared right after landing the final blow... Oh well, doesn't matter! It's better she's gone!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Excuse us! Make way, everyone, Hypa has something to say!
Hella pushes Hypatia into the center of the crowd.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Go on! We went over this. What's your opening line again?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Guys... I'm sorry. I made many impulsive decisions without consulting you all first. You guys must have been really worried.
Hella clears her throat, gently prompting her to continue.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: And...?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Thank you, everyone. I'm home.
At the highest point of the city, the blue-haired woman stands on a jutting rock. She flips the coin in her hand while watching the celebrating crowd far below.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: If that girl hadn't turned back then, I might have actually dug up something else underground. But... what's done is done, so be it.
The threat outside Furor has been eliminated, and the underground treasures are likely mostly destroyed. She has no reason to stay here anymore.
The woman remains silent. After a moment, she lets out a soft sigh.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: In the end, you're still choosing to put your lives in someone else's hands.
She flips the coin once more and catches it. Without looking at the result, she turns and leaves Furor without a moment's hesitation.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Farewell. I may not understand this hope you all speak of, but if this is what you want...

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Then I wish you all the best in surviving the fate you've chosen to embrace.

Under the sky framed by a ring of rocks, the Furorians are all sobbing uncontrollably. Hypatia flutters about frantically, trying her best to comfort the townspeople. Meanwhile, Hella bounces into the crowd from behind, only to be dragged out by her ear by Horo before receiving a stern lecture.

The dark clouds have dissipated completely. The Furorians pin the broken insignia back onto Hypatia's chest. It's no longer pristine and perfect, yet somehow it's reflecting a light more brilliant than ever before.
Everyone is talking and laughing. The sandy wind shrouding Furor has finally disappeared, and sunlight streams down from above, illuminating the land.
Tomorrow will be a new day.
Hella scans the area, eventually spotting Hypatia in a quiet corner away from the crowd.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey! What's the great hero doing, spacing out here?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...It's nothing. Maybe I'm just overthinking things.

Hypatia is gazing at the recent battlefield. The ground has been blasted open into a crater that leads straight underground, and the once-sophisticated Aurum Secretum furnace now lies destroyed, tilting among the ruins.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The crisis is over, but we can't linger in Furor. Don't put too much trust in Synex. She may have helped us then, but she could still rat on what happened here. We should leave as soon as possible...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Mmm-hmm, that's right, no thanks to the anonymous benefactor.
The woman who should have left long ago is perched on a rocky ledge above them, watching the shocked pair below with casual self-satisfaction.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: What, after everything I've done, am I still not welcome here? That stings!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: I was hoping to catch an informant while I was at it, but unfortunately she got away. Anyway, I heard our permanently poker-faced Hypatia is finally starting to look a bit more like a living young girl... Can't miss the chance to witness that kind of wonder, can I?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: And you, clever little thing from DisCity...
Synex turns her gaze toward Hella, her eyes gleaming with heightened interest.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: So you're Hella? I thought you were just some fragile dummy, but you've got more wits than I gave you credit for. Strays are always welcome at my place, and I treat my pets very well. Consider the offer, will ya?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ??? Ugh, no, take that offer back please. Sounds super dodgy!
Synex bursts into laughter. Then suddenly, she looks up into the distance, her smile turning enigmatic.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh my... Looks like I won't be the only one making offers... Lucky you, little Hella.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Eww! Stop with the cryptic nonsense, you weirdo.

Hella isn't done calling her out yet, but a sudden commotion erupts among the crowd nearby. The Furorians grow restless, gathering with mixed expressions of joy and shock around something—exactly in the direction Synex has been looking.
Someone is arriving? Hella stands on tiptoes trying to sneak a peek, but the crowd blocks her view of whatever is causing the commotion. She can only hear the person's voice.
You've protected the research, saved the people of Furor, and upheld your honor... You've grown so much. The Campbell family will be proud of you.
Someone is approaching. Hella feels Hypatia's hand suddenly tighten around hers. Hypatia's voice trembles, her fingertips ice-cold.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Didn't you say... you were heading to DisCity?
Indeed, I've received an order from the city, on top of my many other official duties. But I still seized the chance to request half a day off to visit my baby sister while I'm passing by the area.
You've made a good friend from far away, Hypatia. I'm happy for you.
The man moves through the crowd and stops directly in front of the three of them.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Hello, Hella, and friends from the Legion. I am Adelaide Campbell, advisor to Fraser, nominal head of the Campbell family, and Hypatia's brother. My sister has been in your care, and I must express my deepest gratitude to you all.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Would our esteemed guests like to visit <color=#fb9259>Fraser</color>? I believe it was your intended destination all along...
